## Transfer-Fidelity + Buildability Audit - 2026-04-06

Transfer-fidelity audit goal: separate ledger-to-plan transfer misses from broader plan quality; audit-only (no planning doc edits); evidence: 34 subauditor reports + spot checks + owner reads; lenses: UX/flow, state/storage/commands/audit, tools/permissions/identity, cross-doc consistency/precedence/routing ownership

Raw themes deduped into recurring clusters: export taxonomy/manifest; settings/requested-vs-effective/identity display; project-summary/escalation/blocked-owner/resurfacing; projection-trust UI/gating/fallback; governance record schemas/envelopes; lane/worktree lifecycle/cleanup; route/open-subject/bridge-field refinement; glossary/help terminology collapse

Recurring drift patterns: refinement layer omitted after base primitive; owner updated but consumers not canon-collapsed; storage keys without field schema; UI docs missing operational policy layer; cross-doc primitives not machine-verifiable owners

Cluster A transfer misses (Orchestrator UI/progress/notification/projection): Widget_System Progress-only scope landed but Progress widget catalog + deterministic drill-target mapping not transferred; Orchestrator_Page missing blocked-owner taxonomy, resurfacing/aging, concern action policy, projection fallback ladder, saved-view/sort-defaults, historical mode, search scope/switch disclosure, dense-tab scale; FinalGUISpec missing escalation ladder semantics, notification narrowing, project-card blocked-owner/primary-reason/pressure-summary, settings display grammar, help structure, action-surface/shortcut/context-menu policy

Cluster B transfer misses (storage/governance records): storage-plan missing field schemas for project_summary.v1, project_attention_item.v1, account_pressure_episode.v1, account_switch_event.v1, broader governance/runtime envelope families; bridge fields exist but precedence/join + compatibility fallbacks under-specified; Runtime_Artifacts_Panel envelope fields landed but per-family behavior + bridge governance not fully transferred

Cluster C transfer misses (identity/attribution): Prompt_Pipeline missing unified execution-role + operational/account identity layer; Contracts_V0 missing execution_role in attempt/runtime families + incomplete blocked-family/ref-family separation; Tools tool.invoked analytics-thin vs richer attribution packet; GitHub_API_Auth_and_Flows login-keyed vs stably account-keyed; orchestrator-subagent-integration preserves TierContext-era live canon vs execution_unit_context direction

Cluster D transfer misses (route/open/bridge): Contracts_V0 missing selector precedence, reject rules, closed tab_id vocabulary, scoped resolver rules, concrete route examples, resume_url serialization classes; UI_Command_Catalog missing per-command command_kind/normalization metadata + canonicalized navigation-family treatment; FileManager OpenSubject partial on runtime-lineage families; Wiring_Matrix/Progression_Gates/evidence.schema.json route-aware extensions incomplete; chain-wizard-flexibility/FinalGUISpec still treat resume_url as primary routing vs derived transport in places

Cluster E transfer misses (lifecycle/glossary/help): WorktreeGitImprovement missing full lane/worktree lifecycle vocab, cleanup semantics, gating, transitions; Glossary orchestrator rewrite terms empty vs ledger transfer; FinalGUISpec/glossary/help missing help-entry template, related-concept linking, high-risk term-pair distinction rules

Cluster F same-file supersession failures: human-in-the-loop mixed request/tier-era with newer blocked-runtime; usage-feature older tier-era correlation coexists with corrective text; Contracts_V0/storage-plan/FinalGUISpec/UI_Command_Catalog show mixed-era layering without retiring older framing

Additional buildability gaps: prose-only primitive boundaries; evidence/gates cannot structurally prove richer routing; docs imply stronger shared contract than owned — secondary behind missed-transfer clusters

False-positive exclusions (not missing transfer): route_target/OpenSubject/command_kind/normalizes_to_contract/target_kind/object_kind/inspector_target already in Contracts_V0; requested_account_id/requested_account_binding/operational_identity not wholly absent; account pressure/switch families exist — missing schema/detail layer; projection_freshness/health exist — missing operational trust UI layer. Focus refinements not re-claim total absence.

Transfer audit owner order hint: primary Contracts_V0, storage-plan, Prompt_Pipeline, Orchestrator_Page, FinalGUISpec, UI_Command_Catalog, Glossary, WorktreeGitImprovement; consumers human-in-the-loop, usage-feature, FileManager, orchestrator-subagent-integration, Runtime_Artifacts_Panel, chain-wizard-flexibility, assistant-chat-design; mirrors downstream

Reconciliation direction: owner contracts/schemas first; collapse same-file mixed-era in primary consumers; route/blocked/attribution end-to-end across owner+consumer; mirrors/checklists after stable canon

Do-not-forget implementation risks: missing field schemas → incompatible shapes; mixed canon → contradictory behavior by section; missing route/ref boundaries → shadow routing; missing blocked/escalation/resurfacing → inconsistent UX/persistence; missing cleanup rules → destructive ambiguity

Sharpened misses: Orchestrator_Page/Widget_System — 13-widget Progress catalog effectively absent as named catalog; default drill-target mappings absent; Orchestrator_Page/FinalGUISpec/Glossary — state/action label set, alert-level taxonomy, event-family taxonomy, backbone events, condition-aging policy largely untransferred

Identity/attribution/blocked-policy misses: execution_role absent in many docs; requested_account_id absent where expected; operational_identity partial; account switch/pressure named but under-owned at contract; blocked_sequence minting ownership missing; startup recovery handshake incomplete; DAE jail/approval gaps; usage lacks switch-history/execution-role follow-through

Net rerun result: more concrete misses in widget/event/alert detail, historical/search state, concern/governance schemas, settings/help/project-status structures, route primitive indexing/bridge precedence/gate follow-through, blocked-sequence/startup-recovery/DAE ownership — central conclusion unchanged: ledger transferred only partially; gaps concentrated in schemas/enums/operational policies/routing refinements/same-file collapse
